name: Sabine Süsstrunk
one_sentence_summary: Sabine Süsstrunk leads IVRL at EPFL, researching computational photography, color image processing, computer vision, and image quality, with recent highlights including three CVPR 2026 papers, new SIGGRAPH 2026 publications on neural automata, an HDR diffusion preprint, and three invited talks at high-profile venues.
matrix_summary: IVRL has a new arXiv preprint on HDR reconstruction via diffusion (*ExpandDiff*, Sept 2026), confirmed TIP 2026 acceptance for *VibrantLeaves*, and the NCA/NPA papers are clarified as SIGGRAPH 2026 publications. Prof. Süsstrunk gave three notable invited talks in September at the Swiss Vision Symposium, Paul Scherrer Institute, and the HUAWEI Alps Summit, while Dr. Martin Everaert completed his PhD (Oct 2026).
